self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Tireless Hunt: after hitting an opponent with a Charged Attack, Charged Attack DMG is increased by 160% (R1) / 320% (R5) of Elemental Mastery, for up to 12 Charged Attacks or 10s, once every 12s. Modelled as charged_dmgIncFromEleMas_, which reads the scored build's own EM. It was previously a flat +320/+640 standing in for a hardcoded ~200 EM, because that key was thought not to exist - it does. Set an uptime on this condition for the once-every-12s cadence (~45% on a Sethos rotation).

en.flavor: This gilded bow was made using precious white branches. It has felled countless wicked beasts attempting to infiltrate the woods.

passive.name: At the End of the Beast-Paths

refinements.1: Ganha <r>12%</r> de Bônus de Dano de todos os Elementos. Obtém o efeito "Caça Incansável" ao acertar um oponente com um Ataque Carregado. Esse efeito aumenta o Dano do Ataque Carregado em <r>160%</r> da Proficiência Elemental. Esse efeito será removido depois 12 Ataques Carregados ou após 10s. Só é possível obter 1 efeito de Caça Incansável a cada 12s.
